entities.summary: August Holmgren is a Danish professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 144, achieved on 28 July 2025 and a doubles ranking of No. 284, achieved on 9 June 2025. He is currently the No. 3 player from Denmark.
